name: Men's CAP dark blue polo long sleeves, screen-printed CAP seal in white on the left breast (overlay, registered to garment-polo-male-long)
size_basis: The CAP seal asset insignia-cap-seal (the official seal vector, Fig A6-4 size) reduced to a single white print, layer by layer from the official file's own classes: the gold rings, the lettering, the 13 stars, the triangle and the eagle solid white, the cloud and torse as outlines, the shield as a white outline, the white band, the gray field and the propeller in the shirt colour (#171b1f, sampled in-browser from the Vanguard product photo of the CAP uniform golf shirt with seal (male, not personalized), SKU CAP0320, https://www.vanguardmil.com/cdn/shop/files/CAP0321_1.jpg (1024 x 1024); shirt pixels = every pixel with max channel < 140 and blue >= red and >= green, n = 458,157 of 1,048,576, sorted by luminance; percentiles p5 #0f1317, p25 #14181b, p50 #181c1f, p75 #1a1f24, p95 #1d242d; means: shadow p0-p10 #0f1215, body p30-p70 #171b1f, lit face p60-p90 #1a1f23, lit p85-p97 #1d2228; one photo, so estimated. Body = the p30-p70 mean, highlight lines = the p85-p97 mean, shadow / outline = the p0-p10 mean. Replaces the Figure 5.5 drawing's #001b52, which was too saturated.). Diameter 2.93 in = the embroidered seal measured on Figure 5.5 (the printed polo has no figure of its own and no photograph is on disk; ESTIMATE that the print is the same size), centred on the wearer's left breast at the mirror of the embroidered seal's position about the centre line (print_seal_slot of garment-polo-male-long). CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.2 says "screen-printed in white lettering on the left breast" and no accoutrements (5.3.2.1.2).
documented: dark blue knit polo with the CAP seal screen-printed in white on the left breast, long or short sleeves (CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.2)
no accoutrements: no name, badge or embroidered seal (5.3.2.1.2)
assumed: which seal parts print solid, as outline or are knocked out (single-colour reduction of the official seal vector, seal-from-official.js print())
the men's sheet's pocket group (id pocket) is hidden by the engine for the printed polo: it has no pocket
